messages:
elaine (PM): quick readout 1: we need a sequencing call for Q2 roadmap candidates: Org Pinning, Adaptive Batching, and Predictive Prefetch. put my rough RICE below, looking for quick flags (contracts, infra blockers, legal).

jason (Product Ops): dropping numbers from sales feedback:
Predictive Prefetch: Reach ~25k, Impact ~0.9, Confidence 0.55, Effort 9 => RICE ~1375
Adaptive Batching: Reach ~22k, Impact ~0.65, Confidence 0.7, Effort 5 => RICE ~2000
Org Pinning: Reach ~6k, Impact 1.4, Confidence 0.95, Effort 2 => RICE ~3990

matt (Eng): notes: Prefetch is the biggest infra lift (cache + admission layer); Batching is runtime + SDK changes; Pinning is routing metadata + small UI.
aiden (Infra): Prefetch will require cross-team quota and ops on ingress. can't start without headcount or deprioritizing another infra project.

sophia (Design): Pinning UI is straightforward for MVP (toggle + audit view). we'll need admin copy and an audit export CSV. estimate 2 design days.

elaine (PM): important context: Acme Health's renewal depends on "model pinning + audit trail" before their compliance review in 6 weeks. sales flagged as blocking.

jason (Product Ops): confirmed with AE: renewal escalated, legal wants a concrete roll plan. this turns Pinning into a contractual priority.

matt (Eng): contractual priority means we should spin up a small focused deliverable: MVP Pinning = per-org model tag + routing enforcement + simple audit log. 2 sprints if we scope tightly.

sophia (Design): agree with tight scope. will produce admin flows and edge-state messaging (what happens if pinned model is unavailable).

elaine (PM): sequencing options: 1) Pinning first -> Batching -> Prefetch; 2) Batching -> Prefetch -> Pinning (risky for Acme); 3) Parallel split: small Pinning squad + Batching team, Prefetch later.
aiden (Infra): Option 3 needs extra engineers we don't have. Option 1 seems realistic with current capacity.

priority-bot: lightweight poll opened: "Select Q2 order: 1=Pin->Batch->Prefetch, 2=Batch->Prefetch->Pin, 3=Parallel split"

jason (Product Ops): recommend Option 1 given contract. sales already drove timeline.
matt (Eng): +1. add hard launch criteria for Pinning: per-org routing enforced in canary, audit log retention configured, and no p95 latency regression >10ms.
sophia (Design): +1 on criteria. I'll author admin copy and include a quick accessibility check.

elaine (PM): plan: lock Option 1 unless objections by EOD. action items: - Elaine: Pinning PRD draft by EOD Thurs - Matt: spike for routing + metrics - Sophia: design mockups and copy by Wed - Jason: notify AE/legal and capture acceptance criteria - Aiden: quick infra checklist for audit storage

matt (Eng): add telemetry event: pin.created, pin.removed, request.tagged. track latency delta per-org.

priority-bot: poll closed 7 votes -> Option 1 wins.

elaine (PM): proceeding with Option 1. we'll keep low-priority exploratory work on Batching (keep backlog spike) and defer Prefetch scoping until Q3. will update roadmap doc and sprint board. :thumbsup:

jason (Product Ops): I'll update the renewal tracker and loop legal.
aiden (Infra): will prepare estimated infra cost for audit retention options (S3 vs DB) by next Tues.
sophia (Design): uploading first mockups to figma and will ping for reviews.
matt (Eng): setting up spike tasks and will pair with product for acceptance tests.

elaine (PM): thanks team. locking sequence now. if anything critical surfaces, @channel and we'll re-evaluate.
